g.text: Assigned end-of-year net receipts and initial costs, no salvage or taxes. Both alternatives provide the same service over5 years. Present worth
isΣCt/(1+i)^t; under these assumptions B has the higher value. Unequal lives or materially different service require a compatible comparison basis.
